name: dsh-glm-quota
description: GLM Coding Plan quota display for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: 5h/weekly credit windows, plan expiry and cash balance, shown next to the composer model selector when the zai-coding-cn provider is selected.
_comment: main: lib/index.js —— 宿主半侧入口（Cordis 插件：name/inject/apply）
exports['./client'] —— 浏览器半侧入口，DSH 模块系统按它提供 /plugins/dsh-glm-quota/client.js
dsh.bundle.patch —— 声明本包是 bundle，patch 文件是 cordis.patch.yml
dsh.client —— 声明浏览器半侧的注入依赖和平台（web）
peerDependencies —— 运行时由宿主（DSH）提供的模块，本包不打包它们
